data: Does the blue line representing LDA-GN precision consistently have a higher value than the red dotted line representing LDA precision across all threshold values?

The blue line representing LDA-GN precision is consistently above the red dotted line representing LDA precision across all threshold values. This can be observed in both graphs (a) and (b). The blue line starts slightly below the red dotted line at lower thresholds but surpasses it and remains above throughout the range of thresholds shown.
